narrative:
Plant utilisation averages ~79% across the network. The footprint programme — two German site closures and the new Rzeszów factory — is the largest swing factor: under-absorption during ramp-up could cost EUR 40–60M if transfers slip.

Material Ledger actual cost, now visible per material and plant through Datasphere zero-copy, shows steel and resin prices stabilising but electronics (Home Connect modules) still 4% above standard. The agent recommends pulling forward floorcare transfers and loading the Chuzhou fridge line with Southeast Asia export volume.

This replaces the manual plant-loading workbook that Manufacturing Controlling rebuilds every cycle.

signals.title: Manufacturing Footprint Programme
signals.excerpt: Two German sites closing; volume transferring to the new Rzeszów factory. Under-absorption during ramp-up is the largest cost risk in FY2026.

signals.title: Material Ledger Actual Cost Close
signals.excerpt: Actual cost variances on steel, resins and electronics now visible per material and plant in near-real time — replacing month-end BW extracts.
